about.intro_lead: I'm Emily, 26, and I live on the coast of São Paulo. These days I'm a full stack developer, still finishing my Software Engineering degree at Universidade Cesumar. But I didn't start in tech. And that part of the story is the one that explains me best.
about.intro_p1: Before any line of code, there was the lab bench. As a teenager I did technical courses in Chemistry and Environmental Science at Escola Municipal 1º de Maio. Then came five years as a Laboratory Technician at the Catholic University of Santos, surrounded by research, pipettes and reports. It was there, almost by accident, that technology hooked me. I found out the thing I love most is taking a problem apart to see how it works inside.
about.intro_p2: In 2023 I made the call and jumped. I joined Cubos Academy to actually learn web development and started a Software Engineering degree at the same time. I studied at night, after my shift at the lab. It was hard, I won't romanticize it. In September 2024 the first shot came: an internship at Boneside. A few months later I became a Junior Developer. And in early 2026, Mid-level.
about.intro_p3: Today, as a Mid-level Developer at Boneside, I handle the technical side of a multi-tenant SaaS ERP and juggle other projects too. I go from the architecture sketch all the way down to polishing the screen. The backend is .NET 10, C#, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server and PostgreSQL. The frontend, Angular and React with TypeScript. Along the way, Clean Architecture, Azure, Docker and Tailwind. I use AI every day, but as a tool, checking what it hands me. Deep down, that's what moves me: tech as a way to change things. And looking from the lab bench to here reminds me that starting over was worth every short night of sleep.
